description: A volunteer organization transports voters to the polls on Election Day either by vans or cars. They have vans which can carry 6 people and cars which can carry 3 people.  They need to transport at least 200 voters to the polls. In addition, at most 30% of the vehicles can be vans. How many of each vehicle should be used to minimize the total number of cars used?

VoterCapacityVan.definition: Number of voters a van can carry

VoterCapacityCar.definition: Number of voters a car can carry

MinVoters.definition: Minimum number of voters to transport

MaxVanPercentage.definition: Maximum percentage of vehicles that can be vans

objective.description: "The goal is to minimize the total number of cars used to transport voters"

constraints.description: (number of vans) <= 0.3 * ((number of vans) + (number of cars))
Number of vans and number of cars must be non-negative integers

numberOfVans.definition: Number of vans used to transport voters

numberOfCars.definition: Number of cars used to transport voters
